primary_hypothesis: Joint identity and update decoding improves grounded temporal answer accuracy beyond the strongest shared-candidate independent and iterative baselines on held-out natural histories.
primary_comparator_selection: Select strongest shared-candidate pipeline by development-set primary metric, tie-break by cost; freeze before test evaluation.
split_rule: All sources, aliases, question paraphrases and time prefixes of a connected history stay together. Freeze source manifests and split IDs before final method selection.
counts_note: Planning targets only. Pilot histories may enter training/development but never the untouched test. Revise using throughput and uncertainty needs, never test performance.
threshold_rule: Set from pilot costs and practical QA value before test access; report interval estimates even if threshold is missed.
stochastic_runs: Use at least three seeds for trained scorers where feasible; log decoder determinism and model settings. Do not duplicate deterministic runs as independent evidence.
uncertainty: Paired bootstrap over history groups for primary difference. Query-micro scores are secondary. Report effective group counts and small-sample limitations.
test_policy: One frozen method-selection decision. Label corrections are blind to system identity and applied across all methods with a change log.
annotation_policy: Model-assisted evidence review in this conversation, explicitly disclosed; no claim of human adjudication unless actual user/human review occurs.
development_pilot_exclusion: The Starbucks and Nike 2024 leadership histories, the Lyft FY2024 forecast correction illustration, and connected histories are development-visible and cannot enter an untouched test.
representation_attribution_limit: Six variants share migrated claims. Exact projection loses bounds, observations and negative claims and retains legacy persistence assumptions; measures the implemented representation/materialization bundle, not joint decoding. Prior-to-v0.3 differences also include model-assisted semantic migration.
model_pilot_status: Fresh read-only Jobs ps UNAVAILABLE; auth succeeds. Three conversational generations completed: first candidate pass, one accepted source-only repair, one 32-item ordinal scorer. Zero pinned runs, model weights, dependency installs or cloud jobs.
coupled_attribution_limit: Authored graphs/constant singleton scores only. Restarted iterative matches exact on the constructed trap; both optimize an incorrect identity in misleading-score control. No natural superiority, calibrated certainty or scalability claim.
new_discovery_status: The preserved v0.4 register has five development-visible histories and eleven sources. v0.5 captured eight current HTTP responses for one Lyft correction pair; historical first availability remains unverified and no benchmark history is admitted.
correction_attribution_limit: Ten authored cases, 44 predictions and 544 contracts establish implementation behavior only; all four methods agree under easy authored scores. One natural source pair yields 8 record decodes and 40 representation checks, zero QA and no learned scoring. Certificate removal is a semantic control over identical full context, not blind earlier-prefix extraction or an independently learned method.
correction_semantic_scope: Conditional whole atomic assertion replacement with persistent notices and conjunctive essential-support dependencies. Pure retraction, partial field/endpoint edits, notice reversal and disjunctive support are unsupported.
correction_objective: Historical interpretation remains default. Experimental active_support replaces inactive resolved/temporal terms by existing unresolved/null references. Shared unchanged-score ablation suppresses valid correction edges; no objective is identified with factual truth.

source_demonstration_protocol.source_annotation: unversioned conversational source-only annotation with retained full input fingerprints

next_evidence_gate: Independently measure candidate recall and supported competing alternatives. Three fixed ordinal codings are stable on this case; broader scale sensitivity, calibration, pinned execution and independent histories remain necessary before accuracy or algorithmic claims.

objective_ablation_protocol.negative_result: All 40 authored and 4 source selected correction links disappear under active-support with unchanged authored scores; source 50-only becomes 500+50.
objective_ablation_protocol.inference: This diagnoses objective sensitivity and does not compare natural accuracy.

natural_v06_protocol.roles: Separate source-only candidate and scorer contexts; repair sees original failed output under a one-repair budget. All are unversioned conversational roles, not a pinned runtime or human annotation.
natural_v06_protocol.score_type: Elicited ordinal evidence judgments; never inferred token log probabilities.
natural_v06_protocol.conclusion: Shared-cache execution only; no QA/accuracy/recall, competing resolved identity alternatives, correction contrast or joint advantage.
natural_v06_protocol.future_runtime_requirement: Pinned tokenizer token budget and explicit source-coverage/chunking policy; byte counts are not token counts.

ordinal_sensitivity_protocol.declaration_timing: After scorer completion reported, before root inspected raw values or natural decoder outputs; not ex ante benchmark preregistration.
ordinal_sensitivity_protocol.interpretation: Stability under three fixed codings on one development case; not universal ordinal invariance, calibration, accuracy or a best mapping.
